# Deploy manifests do not cover the host disk-cap scripts

## Context

Operator ruling 2026-09-08: Option 1 approved — add docker-storage-cap.sh and journald-cap.sh to both OBS_PATHS and MATERIALIZER_PATHS, and teach check_deploy_manifest.py to derive *-cap.sh scripts automatically so future cap scripts cannot be omitted. No new CAP_PATHS mechanism (mechanism-ratchet: prefer existing sets). Per ADR 0112 operator-settable caps must deploy when changed.

Plan-review clarification: the derivation rule must be non-vacuous for every existing `infra/**/*-cap.sh` script. Current main has four host cap scripts:

- `infra/scripts/docker-storage-cap.sh`
- `infra/scripts/journald-cap.sh`
- `infra/scripts/vartmp-cap.sh`
- `infra/scripts/container-cap.sh`

All four are consumed by `infra/scripts/compose-up.sh --install` and by `infra/scripts/observability.sh` read/check paths. Therefore the implementation will cover all four in the existing `MATERIALIZER_PATHS` and `OBS_PATHS` manifests, rather than creating a new CAP_PATHS mechanism. The deploy-manifest checker will keep its existing union coverage check and add a derived per-manifest cap check: every derived `infra/**/*-cap.sh` path must be covered by both `MATERIALIZER_PATHS` and `OBS_PATHS` unless explicitly excluded with a reason.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` lists all existing `infra/scripts/*-cap.sh` scripts in `MATERIALIZER_PATHS`, because `compose-up.sh --install` consumes those installers.
- [x] `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` lists all existing `infra/scripts/*-cap.sh` scripts in `OBS_PATHS`, because `observability.sh` reads/checks those cap sources.
- [x] `scripts/check_deploy_manifest.py` derives `infra/**/*-cap.sh` automatically and verifies cap coverage against the existing consuming manifests (`MATERIALIZER_PATHS` and `OBS_PATHS`), with no new curated `CAP_PATHS` set.
- [x] A regression test in `tests/unit/test_check_deploy_manifest.py` proves the derivation is non-vacuous: removing a cap script from either consuming manifest makes the deploy-manifest checker fail.
- [x] Targeted verification passes: `checked: env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_check_deploy_manifest.py`.
- [x] Final gate passes before push: `checked: env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2`.
